serverInfo.name: LiveSpot
serverInfo.description: LiveSpot is an independent Swedish event guide. Use it to find concerts, theatre, sport, comedy, festivals, and family events happening in Swedish cities. Covers Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, and dozens of other cities.
